# Original research figures

Six publisher figure images reproduced under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The article license statements include images unless a separate credit line excludes them. The selected figure captions have no separate third-party exclusion.

- Zheng, G. X. Y. et al. (2017). *Massively parallel digital transcriptional profiling of single cells*. Nature Communications 8, 14049. Figures 1, 2, 3. https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms14049
- Ratz, M., von Berlin, L., Larsson, L. et al. (2022). *Clonal relations in the mouse brain revealed by single-cell and spatial transcriptomics*. Nature Neuroscience 25, 285–294. Figures 1, 3, 5. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41593-022-01011-x

Image bytes are unchanged from publisher downloads. Browser display applies zoom, panning, and a separate guide outline. Chinese explanations, questions, and focus regions are authored by Omics Studio; they are not the authors’ original captions. Original image colors and labels are retained. Source URLs, SHA-256 hashes, authors, titles and license links are in manifest.json. Verified 2026-10-16.
